title: Why Your Weed Hits Differently Every Time (And How to Choose Smarter at Star Buds)

blocks.html: Have you ever bought the same strain twice and had totally different experiences? One time you’re relaxed and giggly, the next you’re stuck on the couch overthinking a text from 2016. You’re not imagining things: cannabis doesn’t hit the same every time, and there are real reasons why.
At Star Buds, we believe better cannabis experiences start with better understanding. Here’s why your weed can feel different—and how to shop smarter next time.
Terpenes Matter More Than You Think
Most people focus on THC percentages, but terpenes—the aromatic compounds in cannabis—play a huge role in how a product makes you feel.
Two products with identical THC levels can feel completely different depending on terpene content. That’s why Star Buds budtenders always look beyond the number.

Hydration, sleep, stress, food intake, and tolerance all influence how cannabis affects you. Even the time of day matters. That “perfect” strain from last weekend might hit differently after a long workday or an empty stomach.

Cannabis degrades over time. Heat, light, and air break down cannabinoids and terpenes, dulling effects and flavor. Shopping at a regulated dispensary like Star Buds ensures proper storage and fresh inventory—something you won’t get from unregulated sources.
How to Choose Smarter at Star Buds

items: Ask about terpene profiles, not just THC
Tell your budtender how you want to feel
Rotate strains instead of chasing the highest percentage

blocks.html: Cannabis is personal, and when you shop intentionally, it shows!
